newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 13,800 MT were 80 percent below the week earlier and the 4-week average. Major increases were for Mexico (8,400 MT, of which 6,300 MT was rough), the Dominican Republic (8,300 MT), the Netherlands (6,000 MT), South Africa (4,500 MT), and Haiti (3,300 MT). In addition, decreases of 23,000 MT of rough rice sales for Costa Rica were the result of switches to optional origin.

Exports of 78,200 MT were up 11 percent from the previous week and 73 percent from the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Japan (40,200 MT), Saudi Arabia (10,100 MT), Mexico (7,400 MT), South Africa (4,900 MT), and the Philippines (4,700 MT).
